_description: MariaDB / MySQL: data bind, shared memory for InnoDB temp tables, and a TCP health check on 3306.
_comment: A RECIPE: `uxc deploy mariadb` pulls the server, creates /srv/mariadb with the right owner, seeds a 0600 environment file and registers the bind + a TCP health check. The root password is NOT set for you - edit /srv/mariadb/env before the first start. A shared recipe must not ship a database password, and a placeholder people forget to change is worse than a container that refuses to start.

_source._comment_image: Major-version tag: a MariaDB major upgrade runs mariadb-upgrade against the data dir and is not reversible, so it must never happen unattended. check_updates follows 11 for patch releases.

_comment_paths: The image runs mysqld as uid/gid 999. Creating the data dir with that owner avoids the first-start chown of every file and makes a restored backup work straight away.
_comment_seed: 0600, and read at launch via env_file - so the password lives in one file next to the data instead of in the shared registry entry or in this profile.

content: # Environment for the mariadb container, read by uxcd at launch.
# EDIT ME: uncomment ONE of the root-password variables, then
# `uxc start mariadb`. Until you do, the server refuses to initialise
# and says so in its log (`uxc log mariadb`).
# MARIADB_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD=1     # generated once, printed in the log
# Optional: an application database and user created on first start.

_comment_caps: The entrypoint initialises the data dir and then runs mysqld as the 'mysql' user. Listed so the profile also works with --caps minimal.

_registry._comment_shm: Raise this if you tune the buffer pool high. It is RAM.
_registry._comment_volumes: EDIT THIS if /srv is not where your data lives. The data dir is a SUBdirectory of the bind, so the env file next to it never ends up inside the data directory.
_registry._comment_tmpfs: The image ships /run/mysqld (its socket + pid directory), and the bundle mounts a fresh tmpfs over /run - which hides it, and the entrypoint dies with `find: '/run/mysqld': No such file or directory`. A tmpfs of its own at that path restores it.
_registry._comment_health: Probed inside the container's own network namespace, so 127.0.0.1 is correct both on the host stack and in a shared infra netns.
_registry.notes: Deployed from the 'mariadb' recipe. Set a root-password variable in /srv/mariadb/env (0600) BEFORE the first start - without one the server refuses to initialise. Data: /srv/mariadb/data (owned by 999). The first initialisation takes a minute; that is what start_period covers. Back up with mariadb-dump from inside the container: `uxe mariadb mariadb-dump -u root -p --all-databases`; a file-level copy of a running data dir is not a backup.
